ticker_news.title: Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon, and Meta Platforms Just Announced Fantastic News for Nvidia.
ticker_news.description: Tech giants Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon, and Meta Platforms announced combined AI capital expenditures of nearly $700 billion for the year, with sustained strong demand for AI products and services. This massive infrastructure investment is excellent news for Nvidia, the leading GPU chip supplier, as it validates continued robust demand for AI and ensures sustained revenue growth for the chip leader.
ticker_news.author: Adria Cimino

ticker_news.title: Will the Stock Market Crash in 2026? Here's What the Data Suggests Will Happen.
ticker_news.description: The S&P 500 Shiller CAPE ratio is near dot-com bubble levels, raising concerns about market valuation. However, the AI revolution differs from the dot-com boom as companies like Amazon, Microsoft, and Nvidia are generating real earnings and revenue. Investors are shifting from volatile growth stocks to stable blue-chip companies with durable business models to weather current market uncertainty.
ticker_news.author: Adam Spatacco

ticker_news.title: Are Leveraged ETFs Right for Your Portfolio? QLD's Tech Bet vs. SSO's Higher Dividend.
ticker_news.description: The article compares two leveraged ETFs: ProShares Ultra QQQ (QLD) and ProShares Ultra S&P 500 (SSO). Both aim to double daily index returns, but QLD focuses on tech-heavy Nasdaq-100 with higher volatility and fees, while SSO offers broader S&P 500 exposure with lower costs and higher dividends. The article cautions that leveraged ETFs are better suited for tactical traders than long-term investors due to daily leverage resets and amplified downside risk.
ticker_news.author: Sarah Sidlow

ticker_news.title: Prediction: Alphabet Will Be a $5 Trillion Stock by the End of 2027
ticker_news.description: Alphabet is positioned to reach a $5 trillion market valuation by end of 2027, driven by AI-powered momentum in Google Search and Google Cloud. Google Search achieved record $63.1B quarterly revenue (up 17% YoY) with new AI features like AI Overviews and AI Mode boosting engagement. Google Cloud surged 48% YoY to $17.6B quarterly revenue with a massive $240B order backlog. At current P/E ratios and projected earnings growth, Alphabet needs only a 23.4% stock increase to reach $5 trillion, or modest P/E expansion to exceed it.
ticker_news.author: Anthony Di Pizio

ticker_news.title: 3 Monster Stocks to Hold for the Next 3 Years
ticker_news.description: The article recommends three AI-focused stocks for long-term holding: Broadcom benefits from data center demand and custom AI chip opportunities; Alphabet leverages its complete AI stack with cost-advantaged TPUs and growing cloud revenue; Micron capitalizes on the DRAM supply shortage driven by AI infrastructure buildout.
ticker_news.author: Geoffrey Seiler

ticker_news.title: Should You Buy Archer Aviation While It's Below $10?
ticker_news.description: Archer Aviation, a leader in the eVTOL (electric air taxi) market, trades below $10 with a $5 billion market cap. While the company has attracted interest from major tech firms and the military, and Morgan Stanley estimates the low-altitude market could reach $9 trillion, Archer remains pre-revenue. The analyst argues the stock is driven by PR announcements rather than actual business execution and recommends passing on the investment, expecting the price to drop further before potentially recovering.
ticker_news.author: Adam Spatacco

SPY.title: Stock Market Today: Dow Jones, Nasdaq, S&P 500 Futures Tick Up After January Inflation Data — Tri Pointe Homes, Roku, Expedia In Focus (UPDATED)
SPY.description: U.S. stock futures showed mixed performance on Friday ahead of January CPI data. Tri Pointe Homes surged 25.79% following a strategic combination announcement with Sumitomo Forestry. Roku jumped 13.70% after beating earnings expectations, while Expedia dropped 4.97% despite beating estimates due to muted 2026 margin guidance. Markets are pricing a 92.1% probability of unchanged Fed rates in March.
SPY.author: Rishabh Mishra
